result.reason: The clause reaches the fallback by retaining annual automatic renewals and reducing the required notice to 30 days. However, the original arguably permitted termination on 90 days’ notice at any time, while the redline permits only non-renewal at the end of a term. That potentially removes an existing termination right and is not disclosed in the margin comment. The drafting should also refer to expiration or non-renewal rather than a 'Termination Date.'
